name: r3-dispatch-once-fire-at
_comment: N2 (dispatch r3): a PENDING one-time open whose fire_at sorts before now but does not parse (Date.parse NaN): empty (dispatched at the tick time), "!" and hour 25 (refused, intent UNKNOWN); an expanded-year instant that sorts as due and that Date.parse reads (a future time, so not late) but the reservation parseInstant does not (refused); and a healthy due open, to show the tick goes on.
